headline: Approved naming 617 Lexington Street the John J. Jack Daddona Education Center; approved a secondhand dealers license for Pedals & Powder at 85 River St.
summary: Approved a secondhand dealers license for Pedals & Powder at 85 River St, with no sales of e-bikes, and a secondhand dealers license renewal at 215 Lexington Street. Approved naming 617 Lexington Street the John J. Jack Daddona Education Center. Tabled the Fuel Storage license at 245 5th Ave, the Secondhand Dealers License Resolution, and the Rule 95 Resolution.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the 8/3/2026 meeting by voice vote.
Approved a secondhand dealers license for Pedals & Powder at 85 River St, with a condition of no sales of e-bikes, by voice vote.
Tabled the Fuel Storage license at 245 5th Ave until the October 5th meeting, by voice vote.
Approved the secondhand dealers license renewal at 215 Lexington Street by voice vote.
Approved a request for the Law Department to attend the next meeting to discuss the Secondhand Dealers License Resolution, by voice vote.
Tabled the Secondhand Dealers License Resolution, which concerns Roadshow Concepts, by voice vote.
Tabled the Rule 95 Resolution until the October 5th meeting, by voice vote.
Approved the School Committee's request to name 617 Lexington Street the John J. Jack Daddona Education Center, by voice vote.

plain_text:
Licenses & Franchises Committee
Meeting Minutes
September 21, 2026
The Chair called the meeting to order at 7:00 p.m. 
The Clerk called the roll.
Present: Vidal, Logan, and Tzioumis. 
Absent: Brasco, Katz.
Artie Kronenfeld of The Waltham Times was recording the meeting.
Councillor Logan moved approval of the 8/3/2026 minutes. The motion was approved by a voice 
vote.
First agenda item: Secondhand dealers license for Pedals & Powder at 85 River St
Kendall Hayward, owner and petitioner, spoke on his application. They will sell ski and bike 
parts, equipment, etc. related to these sports.  Councillor Tzioumis asked about the $250 and over 
on items process with people dropping items off. President Logan moved approval of the license. 
On the motion, Chairman Vidal ask to amend the motion with the provision of a no sale on e-
bikes. The amendment was accepted and the matter was approved by a voice vote. The motion 
was approved by a voice vote.
Second agenda item: Fuel Storage license at 245 5th Ave
President Logan tabled the matter until October 5th meeting. The motion was approved by a voice 
vote.
Third agenda item: Secondhand dealers license renewal at 215 Lexington Street.
President Logan moved approval of the renewal. The motion was approved by a voice vote.
Fourth agenda item: Secondhand Dealers License Resolution
President logan spoke on the jewelry mailer/flyer Roadshow Concepts mailed to local residents 
and the license we had approved through September 2026 for Roadshow Concepts.  A company 
that rents a room at the Embassy Suites and has fairs for the public to come and exchange goods 
etc. for money. The council l usually approves licenses in this capacity for a specific address. This
is a company from Illinois. President Logan made a request that was approved by a voice vote to 
have the Law Department attend the next meeting to discuss. President Logan moved to table the 
matter. The motion was approved by a voice vote.
Fifth agenda item: Rule 95 Resolution
President Logan tabled the matter until October 5th meeting. The motion was approved by a voice 
vote.
Sixth agenda item: School Committee letter requesting the naming of 617 Lexington Street be 
called the John J. Jack Daddona Education Center 
President Logan spoke on the request and moved approval of the request. On the motion 
Councillor Tzioumis spoke on the matter. She asked about a public hearing. The building is not 
named after anyone so there is not a need to have a public hearing Councillor Logan stated.  Off 
Committee member King spoke and read a statement in support of naming the building after Jack 
Donnona. President Logan moved approval. The motion was approved by a voice vote.
With no further matters Councillor Logan moved to adjourn.
Chairman Vidal declared the meeting adjourned at 7:25 p.m.
Respectfully submitted,
Kara Wilson, Clerk of the Licenses & Franchises Committee
September 23, 2026
